summary: Comprehensive testing of Professional Ticket component for EuroMatchTickets. All frontend tests passed (100%). Ticket preview page at /ticket-preview loads correctly with 3 demo tickets (Football, F1, Concert). All ticket features verified: QR codes, branding, seat info, download buttons, event type badges.
critical_code_review_comments: ProfessionalTicket.jsx has proper data-testid attributes for testing
QR codes rendered correctly using qrcode.react library
Category colors properly mapped (cat1=cyan, grandstand=cyan, floor=pink)
Event type badges correctly mapped (match=FOOTBALL, f1=FORMULA 1, concert=CONCERT)
MyTicketsPage correctly imports and uses ProfessionalTicket for upcoming/past orders
OrderSuccessPage correctly displays ProfessionalTicket with price summary after payment
handleDownload function opens print window with styled ticket HTML
Tear line design implemented with dashed border and decorative circles
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used 3 demo tickets defined in TicketPreviewPage.jsx
context_for_next_testing_agent: Professional Ticket component fully working. /ticket-preview page shows 3 demo tickets. MyTicketsPage requires login to see user orders with professional tickets. OrderSuccessPage shows professional ticket after successful payment. Key data-testid attributes: professional-ticket-{orderId}, ticket-event-name, download-ticket-btn.
